subject.title: feat: bound raw transcript reads across replacements

question: Should OpenClaw introduce schema v12 transcript-generation state and permanently expose `readSessionTranscriptRawDelta` as a Plugin SDK contract for bounded raw transcript consumers?
rationale: This selects durable storage and external API commitments; repository policy requires human acceptance for schema-version changes and compatibility-sensitive SDK direction.

options.title: Approve the foundation
options.body: Accept the v12 migration and cursor API as supported contracts, then continue normal review of the implementation and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep it internal
options.body: Avoid the public SDK export and use a private active-memory-owned bounded reader until a concrete external consumer establishes the API need.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the branch until a state and SDK owner defines the durable cursor and migration contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the v12 migration and cursor API as supported contracts, then continue normal review of the implementation and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is repository-level state and external SDK direction rather than contributor follow-up alone.
